****💻 Role****
 As Whatnot rapidly scales, data is central to shaping our product and operational strategy, helping us build delightful, high\-performing experiences for both buyers and sellers. This is especially important when users reach out for support. We’re looking for a
 **Data Scientist, Customer Experience**
